hero.subtitle: We replace expensive, fragmented tech stacks with AI-built custom apps, White Glove IT support, and Kansas-based sovereign hosting — 100% solar-powered, disability-led, and built around real humans.

services.label: Five Ways We Serve You
services.heading: Every Service Built Around a Real Problem
services.intro: No bundled packages. No unnecessary upsells. Five focused service lines — each one built around a real problem we saw going unsolved.

cards.heading: White Glove Managed IT
cards.description: Real humans. SLA-backed. No offshore call centers. We know your setup before you call — and we're there when it matters.

cards.heading: Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS)
cards.description: Refurbished enterprise hardware on subscription. Zero e-waste. We deploy, manage, and refresh every device on schedule.

cards.heading: AI Custom App Development
cards.description: Replace your $800+/mo SaaS stack with a custom app you own outright — built on AI, hosted on solar, no license fees ever.

cards.heading: Senior Technology Concierge
cards.description: Scam-proof security setup, plain-English support, monthly check-ins. Designed for dignity — not afterthought tech support.

cards.heading: Sovereign Private Hosting
cards.description: Your data lives in Park City, Kansas — in our building, on our servers. HIPAA-ready. Solar-powered. No Big Tech. No exceptions.

values.label: Why Clients Choose Us
values.heading: What Makes Kecktech Different
values.intro: There are a lot of IT companies. Here's what makes us different — and why it matters.

cards.heading: 100% Solar-Powered
cards.body: Our 25kW rooftop array and 100kWh battery bank mean your data runs on sunshine. Lower carbon footprint than any hyperscale cloud — and savings go back into lower prices for you.

cards.heading: Disability-Led & ADA-First
cards.body: Both founders live with physical disabilities. Accessibility isn't a checkbox at Kecktech — it's in the building, the software, the support process, and every client interaction.

cards.heading: Your Data Stays in Kansas
cards.body: We own the servers. We don't scan, sell, or monetize your data. Sovereign hosting means your information lives under your terms — not Amazon's, not Google's.

cards.heading: Real Humans. Real Accountability.
cards.body: No ticket queues. No offshore call centers. No automated runaround. When you need us, a real person picks up — the same people, every time.

cta.heading: Ready for IT That Actually Works for You?
cta.body: No long-term contracts. Transparent pricing. A team that treats every client like a neighbor.
